_comment: Every number a run reads. Region shape, site mix, the Reclaimer front, rewards and prices. Code holds none of these.

region._columns: Column 0 is the start site, the last column is the boss gate; the ones between hold rows_min..rows_max sites each.

refinery._comment: 031: refining a part of rarity r costs costs[r-1] and gives a random part of rarity r+1, the same slot (a rare becomes a legendary).

auction._comment: 031: crates bought blind; `legend_pct` is the chance it holds a legendary instead.

_sites_013: 013: traders (buy from stock, sell from the hold), watchtowers (scout), signals (data/run/events.json).

trader._comment: A trader stocks three parts (one tuned) priced by rarity (+tuned_extra if tuned), and buys parts from the hold for buy_multiplier x what breaking them down pays.

tower._comment: A watchtower scouts every site within `radius` columns.

reclaimer_reach._comment: A fight at a site in the column the Reclaimer takes next: `count` of its drones arrive on the crew's back row at round `round`, marked a round ahead.

_warlord: 030: each act has one warlord site in this column (never its only site): its board (`warlord: true`, by act), `enemies.warlord_escorts`, `rewards.warlord_scrap` and a hoard with a legendary.

front._comment: The Reclaimer consumes one column every `every` moves. Each move made while standing in consumed ground costs every machine `damage` HP (never below 1).

enemies._boss: 013: the gate is its own map (data/fights/sorting_gate.json): the Sorter, its pylons, and `boss_escorts` rolled escorts. boss_count / boss_hp_bonus apply only if no gate map exists.

rewards._salvage: 011: every salvage screen offers `choices` parts from different slots (the second leaning to a maker the crew builds sets from) or `salvage_scrap` scrap instead; an elite's first part comes tuned.

workshop._comment: repair_amount is per machine; a rebuilt wreck comes back at half HP. tune_costs by rarity: tuning a part once, one of its two options (011).

modifiers._comment: 028: the chance, by column, that a fight (not a gate) rolls one yard condition (combat rules `modifiers`), and which. LIVE WIRES lays `wires` tiles.

terrain._comment: Props and pits scattered on generated fights, in the middle rows, per fight: a random count in [min, max].

kinds._comment: Chance, per enemy and by column, that it has special rules, and which rules.

assembly._comment: Play-test 4: at the start of a run the crew is built from a bench. Every part at or below free_rarity is on it without limit; the extras (the default crew's uncommons) once each. RunSim.ASSEMBLE, before the first move only.

levels._comment: Play-test 3: scrap needs something to buy. In the garage a machine buys its next level for costs[level]. bonus[n] is what level n+1 adds (max HP, and that much HP now), and every level also keeps one of `perk_choices` perks (data/run/perks.json, 011). Tuned 2026-09-25: +1 damage on every level took the run bot from 85% to 94%; in 011 the level-2 damage became a perk (Hot Loads).

hold._comment: The hold starts at `start` parts. A workshop sells `expand_by` more room at each price in turn. Going over is allowed after salvage, but travel waits until the hold fits.

scrap_value._comment: Scrap for breaking a part down, by rarity 1..3.

acts.name: THE SLAG FLATS
acts._comment: 021. Laid over the run's rules one level deep while the crew is in Act 2. `arrive` is what breaking the gate before it gives.

acts.name: THE CRUCIBLE
acts._comment: 025. The furnace-city, the run's last act: bigger squads of rare parts that hit harder, conduits, furnace flues on every board, and the Core at its gate.
